scope: Selected historical platform-reported topic and annual audience observations; time-specific discovery is not identical to seasonal creator income

cases.valid_statement: Over 30% of global NFL-related 2025 views occurred in the offseason
cases.limitations: No matched monthly baseline, day count adjustment or offseason share for earlier years; not an NFL fan/person count.

cases.valid_statement: Over 25 million global views of videos with both prom and GRWM in titles over 2024
cases.limitations: No within-year monthly distribution or matched nonprom control; not all prom content or unique prom viewers.

cases.valid_statement: Over 1 billion global views for specified Halloween-makeup titles through October 5, 2025
cases.limitations: Jan–Oct 5 is not a Halloween-week or full-year count; no monthly seasonality curve.

cases.valid_statement: Over 50 million related views in Japanese launch week of Splatoon 2
cases.limitations: Game event, not annual recurring seasonality; no matched baseline and not a single-trailer count.

cases.valid_statement: UK 4–15-year-olds averaged 427 minutes/week of in-home YouTube viewing in 2025
cases.limitations: Annual weekly mean is not term-time versus school-holiday change; no child-level observation collected.

cross_case_comparisons.reason: NFL share denominator (all 2025 NFL views) is not a 2024 annual query-title view-event count
Different year lengths and title queries; prom full year versus Halloween partial year
Japan launch week is one-off event and not comparable to global annual sport season share
In-home measured minutes per UK child and worldwide view events use different population and units

required_for_credible_lift: Pre-register topic and content inclusion rule; preserve specific title and classification definitions
Use equal-duration bins in the same geography, viewer/device population and metric definition epoch
Repeat multiple full calendar cycles and declare coverage, time zone and missing months
Reconcile the August 24 2026 playback-start metric change
Compare a reference category or otherwise model secular platform activity and topic supply
Report missing cells, overlap, uncertainty, nonzero counts and avoidance of post-hoc window selection
Do not infer unique people, subscriber growth, creator gross receipts or profitability from topic view totals
